- Vacuum nozzle pass, slow
- Same spot after, clean

0-2s  Seat slides forward, revealing what's under it. Text: "Nobody looks under here."
2-8s  Vacuum crevice tool passes, close-up. Text: "I do."
8-14s Gap between seat and console. Text: "This gap too."
14-20s Clean after shot, same angle. Text: "Interior {price_interior} - Melrose Park, drop-off"
Audio: trending instrumental or just the vacuum sound. No voice needed.
instagram:
The area under the seat is where fries go to retire.

purpose: Build trust by being upfront about limits; filters out bad-fit requests.

visual: Photo of your supplies or the garage.
shots: - Supplies shelf, tidy
allow_terms: mobile, ceramic, paint correction, polish, extraction
facebook:
Being upfront about what I do and don't do:

I do: interior detailing ({price_interior}), exterior cleaning ({price_exterior}), and both together ({price_full}).

I don't do (right now): paint correction, polishing, ceramic coatings, carpet extraction, or mobile service.

If your car needs one of those, I'll tell you instead of taking your money for something I don't offer. If it just needs a good, honest cleaning, that's me.
